leadManagement.name: Lead Management
leadManagement.description: Tune lead staleness detection for kanban badges and the lead list filter.

fields.label: Stale after (days)
fields.hint: Number of days a lead can stay untouched before it is flagged as stale. Default: 14.

shillinq.name: Shillinq integration
shillinq.description: Shillinq is installed on this server. Pipelinq hands approved hours and expenses to it.

fields.label: Send approved hours to Shillinq as draft invoices
Billing handoff manager group
fields.hint: Nextcloud group allowed to trigger 'Send to billing'. Leave empty to restrict it to Nextcloud administrators.

exportConfiguration.name: BI Export Configuration
exportConfiguration.description: Defaults for the BI export and data-warehouse sink: retention, compression and failure alerts.

fields.label: Retention (days to keep runs)
fields.hint: How long export-run audit records are kept. Default 365 days.

fields.label: Default compression
fields.hint: Used when a destination does not specify its own compression.

fields.label: Failure notification email
fields.patternMessage: Enter an email address, such as alerts@example.com.
fields.hint: Address to notify when an export run fails. Leave empty to disable.

fields.label: At-risk warning (hours without a successful run)
fields.hint: Triggers an at-risk warning if no run has succeeded in this many hours.

marketingIntel.name: Marketing intelligence
marketingIntel.description: Where the keyword, Matomo and competitor reads leave the instance, and how relevance is scored. Every outbound read goes through an OpenConnector source, so this section holds source ids and never a key.

fields.label: Crawl source for our own pages
fields.hint: The OpenConnector source that reaches your own website. The content gap check reads the title and headings of the pages that already appear in search. Leave it empty and that check does not run, which the Keywords page says rather than reporting no gaps.

fields.label: Impressions before a query counts
fields.hint: How many impressions a query needs over the window before any keyword finding names it. Lower it for a small site.

fields.label: Matomo address
fields.hint: Used for links out of the reports. The reads go through the source below.

fields.label: Matomo connector source
fields.hint: The OpenConnector source that reaches your Matomo instance.

fields.label: Matomo credential id
fields.hint: The id of the credential the OpenRegister broker holds for Matomo. Store the token there, not here: a value that looks like a Matomo token is refused.

fields.label: Egress source for competitor reads
fields.hint: The OpenConnector source feeds, sitemaps, page watches and public timelines are read through. A competitor on their own domain can carry a source of its own instead.

fields.label: User agent for competitor reads
fields.hint: How these reads identify themselves to the sites they read.

fields.label: Let hermiq score how relevant an item is
fields.hint: Off by default: it sends a competitor's headline to the model you configured in hermiq. When it is off, or hermiq cannot answer, an item is stored without a score and shown as not scored.

fields.label: What counts as relevant here
fields.placeholder: Tenders at municipalities, open source in the public sector.
fields.hint: Put in front of the model verbatim, in your own words.

provisionData.name: Provision data
provisionData.description: Create or repair the Pipelinq register, schemas, default pipelines and skills. Run it after you enable OpenRegister, or to repair a partial install. Running it twice creates no duplicates.

brpMonitor.name: BRP monitor
brpMonitor.description: Lookups in the persons registry over the last 24 hours, and the mTLS client certificate.

fields.text: Last 24 hours: {report.totalLookups} lookups, {report.cacheHits} from the cache, {report.errorCount} errors, {report.avgResponseMs} ms average response time.
No BRP lookups have been reported yet.

textMap.ok: The mTLS certificate is valid until {cert.expiry}, {cert.daysLeft} days from now.
textMap.warning: The mTLS certificate expires on {cert.expiry}, in {cert.daysLeft} days. Replace it soon.
textMap.critical: The mTLS certificate expires on {cert.expiry}, in {cert.daysLeft} days. Replace it now.

menuStructure.name: Menu structure
menuStructure.description: Choose how much the menu shows. No page is removed: both menus open the same pages.
menuStructure.savedMessage: Saved. People see the change the next time they open Pipelinq.

options.label: Simple
options.description: Nine menu entries for customer contact. Everything else is one step further, on the Modules page or in settings.

options.label: Full
options.description: Every entry in the menu, as it was before.

fields.label: Modules in the simple menu
fields.hint: Switch on what your organisation uses. A module that is off stays reachable from the Modules page.

vatRates.name: VAT rates
vatRates.description: Set the VAT rate for each VAT class. Products use these rates on receipts and invoices.

forecast.name: Forecast configuration
forecast.description: Configure the sales forecast: commit threshold, weekly snapshot schedule, accuracy bands, at-risk warnings and the reporting currency.

fields.label: Reporting currency
fields.patternMessage: Use a three-letter currency code for every rate.

fields.label: Exchange rates
fields.patternMessage: Use a three-letter currency code for every rate.
fields.valueMessage: Every rate must be a number above zero.

prospect.name: Prospect Discovery
prospect.description: Configure your Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) to discover potential leads.

fields.label: SBI Codes
fields.hint: Dutch Standard Industrial Classification codes. One code per line.

fields.label: Keywords
fields.hint: Used for OpenCorporates search. One keyword per line.

fields.label: KVK API Key
fields.hint: Required for prospect discovery. Get one at developers.kvk.nl.

posCustomer.name: POS customer lookup
posCustomer.description: Configure how cashiers search for customers, how much history is shown at checkout, and how marketing consent is synced to the linked contact.

fields.label: Automatically sync marketing consent to the linked contact.
Require a customer for on-account transactions.

cti.name: CTI integration
cti.description: Configure the telephony platform that powers screen-pop and click-to-dial.

xwiki.name: xWiki integration
xwiki.description: Configure the xWiki knowledge base proxy used by the dashboard widget and the detail sidebar tabs. Pipelinq finds xWiki through the xWiki app or through OpenRegister.

fields.label: Default xWiki space
fields.hint: Space name pre-selected by the dashboard widget. Leave empty to search across all spaces.

fields.label: Cache TTL (seconds)
fields.hint: How long search and page results are cached server-side. Default: 300.

fields.label: Test connection
fields.failureText: xWiki not reachable. Install the xWiki app, or connect xWiki through OpenRegister and integriq.
